'''Mandalmatrix''' was a [[Computer/Legends|computer]] security company. [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]] employed their services during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It shared a similar name to the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] corporation known as [[Mandal Hypernautics Corporation|Mandal Hypernautics]].
